Finite enumeration is exhaustive, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The central problem is not another domination number but a natural optimal-code reconfiguration barrier: for all 320 optimum labelings in the canonical 4-cube, one- or two-token repairs cannot move between different minima, whereas the exact three-token replacement graph is connected with diameter 3. Its 27-regularity and equitable two-class quotient give nontrivial navigation structure not supplied by a scalar optimum or mere code-equivalence classification. This is an exact, reusable natural finite classification; no claim is made about other cube dimensions.
